title: The clever little hare and the lion.
lines: This is a very old story from India.
A lion lives in a big forest.
He is big and strong and very greedy.
The other animals are very scared.
They don't dare go outside anymore.
One day all the animals meet at the big tree.
The deer, the monkey, the bear and the hare.
This can't go on, says the deer.
Together they go to the lion.
You don't need to hunt anymore.
Every day we'll send one animal to you.
Then you'll have food, and the others can live in peace.
But if one day nobody comes, I'll eat you all!
Every day one animal goes to the lion.
One day it's the turn of a little hare.
The little hare has long ears and a white tail.
But the little hare is very clever.
I don't want to be eaten, thinks the little hare.
I have to come up with a plan.
The little hare walks very slowly to the lion.
Then the little hare sees an old well.
A deep hole in the ground, full of water.
The little hare looks into the well.
It sees itself in the water.
A little hare with long ears.
Now I know what to do.
It's almost evening when the little hare reaches the lion.
And why are you so small?
You're not even enough for one bite!
There were five of us hares.
But on the way another lion came.
He said: I am the king of this forest.
Come with me, says the little hare.
He lives in a strong fort under the ground.
The little hare takes the lion to the well.
That's where he lives, says the little hare.
The lion looks over the edge of the well.
Deep down in the water he sees a lion.
The sound comes back out of the well.
The lion thinks the other lion is roaring back.
He jumps into the well to fight.
But there is no other lion.
It was only his own reflection in the water.
The lion can't get out again.
The little hare runs back to the forest.
As fast as its little legs can go.
They lift up the little hare and cheer.
Hooray for the clever little hare!
You don't have to be big and strong.
If you think hard, you can do something big too.
And from that day on all the animals live happily and peacefully in the forest again.
